resolvedReviewFindings.finding: LLM request/admission must carry bounded immutable instruction/content artifacts plus canonical output schema/hash, and token/spend admission must compute from exact serialized provider request bytes before transport.
resolvedReviewFindings.fix: Structured LLM requests now include organization/policy/lifecycle metadata and contentArtifacts with exact serialized bytes; canonical provider payload is built before policy admission, hashed as the request, passed to transport, and covered by negative tests proving oversized exact bytes fail before transport and schema generation changes alter hashes.

resolvedReviewFindings.finding: Public API-key specs must remove caller-owned organization/workspace/brain authority and internal IDs from returns, deriving scope server-side or remaining unregistered.
resolvedReviewFindings.fix: Public Confect apiKeys spec no longer accepts caller tenant fields and returns only display-once public metadata; helper derives server scope and strips key/principal/internal tenant ids in tests.

resolvedReviewFindings.finding: ModelCallReceiptRow needs organization, lifecycle/redaction, policy, schema generations and tenant indexes, and gateway/mappers must populate required fields.
resolvedReviewFindings.fix: Receipt row and integration receipt now require organizationId, schemaGeneration, policyGeneration, lifecycleGeneration, and redactionState; gateway populates them and tests validate required fields.

resolvedReviewFindings.finding: Signed-out live/production must never receive fake workspace owner tenancy; fake selection depends on explicit fake/build/local mode.
resolvedReviewFindings.fix: Runtime workspace operations now choose fake tenancy only from explicit AuthKit fake mode; live signed-out paths fail closed and focused tests cover both modes.

resolvedReviewFindings.finding: Provider SDK imports must stay out of route modules; checker must enforce this while preserving server/client provider boundaries and real provider session ids.
resolvedReviewFindings.fix: WorkOS imports moved into dedicated auth runtime/adapter boundary files, root route only imports internal adapters, and provider-boundary checker allows only those boundary files.

resolvedReviewFindings.finding: Eval approval must require external run artifacts and answer eval must score claims/citations/sources mechanically rather than trust booleans.
resolvedReviewFindings.fix: Fixture-only eval reports are rejected for promotion; approval requires external artifact schema and all suite receipts passing. Answer eval now uses claim text, cited quote, locator, and source artifact hash, with negative tests for fixture-only and unsupported artifacts.

resolvedReviewFindings.finding: Export pages/revisions/citations need lifecycle/generation fencing.
resolvedReviewFindings.fix: Brain export contract now requires active lifecycle state and exact lifecycleGeneration for pages, sources, and citations, and records page/source lifecycle generation in revision artifacts.

resolvedReviewFindings.finding: LLM admission must require exact artifact bytes, recompute canonical content root hashes, enforce media/size caps, and derive output schema hash from actual schema before transport.
resolvedReviewFindings.fix: Structured LLM policy now rejects missing bytes, hash mismatches, stale roots, unsupported media, oversize exact payloads, and caller-provided schema hash mismatches before transport; tests assert zero-call rejection.

resolvedReviewFindings.finding: Browser RootComponent must not call getServerEnv or infer fake mode from absent client env.
resolvedReviewFindings.fix: Server loader now serializes SafeClientRuntime with explicit workspaceRuntimeMode; RootComponent consumes that safe mode and no longer reads server env in browser component logic.

resolvedReviewFindings.finding: API-key registered Confect impls were unconditional Unauthorized; generated and manifest registries must agree or group must be unpublished.
resolvedReviewFindings.fix: Unpublished the public Confect apiKeys group and removed generated registered function stubs while retaining helper/domain tests and table contracts.

resolvedReviewFindings.finding: Model receipts need tenant-derived writer/mapper/effect uniqueness with wrong-org/workspace/stale-generation/duplicate tests.
resolvedReviewFindings.fix: Added model receipt repository fence helper with wrong organization, wrong workspace, stale lifecycle generation, and duplicate attempt tests.

resolvedReviewFindings.finding: Fixture-only eval approval must not approve without immutable external run artifacts.
resolvedReviewFindings.fix: Approval now requires per-suite immutable external artifact metadata in addition to passing suite receipts; missing artifacts are rejected.

resolvedReviewFindings.finding: Route loader still directly imported WorkOS server auth and getServerEnv in an isomorphic route; use a createServerFn/server-only boundary returning SafeClientRuntime.
resolvedReviewFindings.fix: Added apps/web/src/auth/safe-client-runtime.server.ts using createServerFn; root route imports only loadSafeClientRuntime and focused tests assert no getServerEnv/getWorkosServerAuth in the route.

resolvedReviewFindings.finding: llmEgressPolicy labeled a zero-padded FNV-1a value as sha256 for output schema integrity.
resolvedReviewFindings.fix: canonicalOutputSchemaHash now computes SHA-256 over canonical schema bytes and tests reject schema substitution/collision-shaped hashes before transport.

resolvedReviewFindings.finding: Model receipt repository was pure validation and did not durably write tenant-scoped receipts.
resolvedReviewFindings.fix: Added DatabaseReader/DatabaseWriter-backed writeModelCallReceipt with tenant fence and duplicate attempt rejection, covered by TestConfect persistence tests.

resolvedReviewFindings.finding: Eval approval trusted URI/hash strings and passed flags instead of loading raw artifacts and recomputing suite/case metrics; answer support self-attested source hashes.
resolvedReviewFindings.fix: Approval now requires raw artifacts, verifies SHA-256 over raw payload, recomputes exact suite receipts/version bindings, and answer scoring verifies source artifact bytes/hash and cited quote support.

resolvedReviewFindings.finding: writeModelCallReceipt had no production Confect/gateway caller, took caller tenant, and queried global by_attempt before duplicate detection.
resolvedReviewFindings.fix: sourceGroundedBrief production capability now calls writeAuthenticatedModelCallReceipt, which derives organization/workspace from requireWorkspaceAccess and the workspace row, maps repository errors to the capability typed surface, and writeModelCallReceipt queries by_workspace_attempt for tenant-scoped duplicate checks.

resolvedReviewFindings.finding: Eval recomputation accepted attacker-supplied fixtures, labels, and expected outputs instead of binding raw results to the frozen corpus/hash/version.
resolvedReviewFindings.fix: Approval recomputation now rejects supplied fixture hash mismatches, evaluates frozen suite fixtures only, passes external run outputs separately where supported, and includes adversarial fabricated-fixture negatives.

resolvedReviewFindings.finding: Maintenance, promptInjection, and multilingual evaluators received only frozenFixture and scored embedded outputs; all five suites needed separate external run inputs with a positive exact five-suite approval and failing bad-run negatives.
resolvedReviewFindings.fix: Added external run schemas/results for maintenance, promptInjection, and multilingual, recomputed all five suite receipts from raw external run artifacts against the frozen corpus, and added positive all-suite approval plus bad maintenance/promptInjection/multilingual run negatives.

resolvedReviewFindings.finding: sourceGroundedBrief fabricated an OpenRouter model receipt around runFakeSourceGroundedBrief with placeholder sha256 strings, fixed usage/cost/time, and a reserved attempt key for a call that did not occur.
resolvedReviewFindings.fix: sourceGroundedBrief now uses createStructuredLlmGateway in fake/local mode, computes canonical request/source/response hashes through the structured gateway and content manifest, persists the actual returned provider/model/hash/usage receipt, and no longer calls runFakeSourceGroundedBrief or writes placeholder sha256 strings.

resolvedReviewFindings.finding: apps/web/src/routes/__root.tsx imported unused ClientAuthSnapshot, failing deterministic full lint.
resolvedReviewFindings.fix: Removed the unused ClientAuthSnapshot type import while preserving SafeClientRuntime loader wiring.

resolvedReviewFindings.finding: sourceGroundedBrief is a Confect mutation but imported @maestro-template/integrations, whose structured LLM hashing path statically imports node:crypto and is not deployable in the Convex isolate runtime.
resolvedReviewFindings.fix: Reverted sourceGroundedBrief to the existing deterministic contract fixture, removed direct gateway/provider execution and fixture receipt persistence from the mutation, removed the Convex package dependency/lock importer on integrations, and added a deployability regression asserting no integrations/node:crypto/gateway/receipt writer usage in the fixture mutation while preserving the authenticated receipt repository contract for a future Node action/service.

resolvedReviewFindings.finding: Eval approval permitted missing root.run values and evaluator fallbacks could score frozen fixture outputs for approval.
resolvedReviewFindings.fix: Approval recomputation now requires every suite raw artifact to include an external run object before evaluator dispatch; missing classification, answers, maintenance, promptInjection, or multilingual run payloads are rejected and covered by a regression test.

resolvedReviewFindings.finding: Deterministic full verify lint rejected thrown tagged errors in appendModelCallReceipt because thrown tagged errors escape the typed Effect/client error contract.
resolvedReviewFindings.fix: appendModelCallReceipt now returns Either.left for ModelReceiptTenantMismatch and ModelReceiptDuplicate planner failures, with negative tests asserting typed Left results for wrong tenant/lifecycle fences and duplicate attempts.
